documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited reported a strong start to FY27 with robust revenue and profitability growth driven by healthy domestic demand and increased automotive production. Management highlighted solid order book visibility, ongoing greenfield and brownfield expansion projects, and an expanding product portfolio in advanced technologies like Mechatronics and alternate fuels. While remaining watchful of macroeconomic uncertainties, the company maintained its full-year guidance and long-term vision to achieve significant revenue and margin growth. Lumax Auto Technologies Limited reported consolidated revenues of INR 1,364 crores for Q1 FY27, representing a 33% increase year-on-year, alongside an EBITDA of INR 205 crores and a PAT before minority interest of INR 99 crores. Management outlined a medium-term plan for FY26 to FY31 targeting a minimum 20% revenue CAGR, a 20% EBITDA margin, and 20% ROCE, backed by a focus on future and clean mobility.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company continues with the similar guidance for the ongoing fiscal year.
guidance.quote: As of now, we continue with the similar guidance.

guidance.claim: The company expects to be able to sustain the current margins achieved in Q1 for the remaining part of the year as well.
guidance.quote: I think I can only say that we will be able to sustain these current margins achieved in Q1 for the remaining part of the year as well.

guidance.claim: The guidance for the full year capex continues to remain around INR 300 crore.
guidance.quote: The guidance for the full year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, which will include the upcoming greenfield expansions of Mechatronics as well as new plants of IAC division.

guidance.claim: Management targets a minimum revenue CAGR of 20% organically and inorganically under its mid-term plan for FY26 to FY31.
The company aims for a vision EBITDA margin of 20% and an ROCE of 20% under the mid-term plan.
The company targets 20%+ contribution from future and clean mobility under its mid-term plan.
The company is confident about continuing to outperform industry growth.
guidance.quote: Hence, my direction and guidance for the year would be that the Company is pretty confident that we will continue to outperform the industry growth.

guidance.claim: Some businesses are expected to grow at 2x to 3x of industry growth.
guidance.quote: I think a few of the businesses we are looking at perhaps doubling that of industry growth, growing by 2x. And in certain business cases, we might as well also grow by 3x of the industry growth on account of various initiatives like value content going up or wallet share expansion.

guidance.claim: The effective tax rate is expected to hold at around 26% moving forward.
guidance.quote: Excluding the same, the effective tax rate for FY 26 comes out as 26%, and we expect it to hold at similar levels way forward.

guidance.claim: The minority share is expected to remain in the 15% to 17% range going forward.
guidance.quote: The minority share for FY 26, however, is at 17%, and which is expected to be in a similar range going forward.

guidance.claim: Lumax Ituran's EBITDA margin is guided for up to 150 basis points improvement internally.
guidance.quote: However, the FY 27 guidance remains in place for up to 150 basis points improvement as is being projected internally right now.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand as we enter the festive season is expected to remain healthy with many leading OEMs reporting low inventory levels.
demand_outlook.quote: As we enter the festive season, demand is expected to remain healthy, with many leading OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers) reporting low inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favorable giving management confidence for the near term.
demand_outlook.quote: While we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favorable, giving us confidence for the near term.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall demand environment and industry outlook continue to be favorable.
demand_outlook.quote: In closing, while we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favourable, giving us confidence as we enter FY 27.

demand_outlook.claim: Vehicle production across segments remained healthy during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: on the back of this improving environment, vehicle production across segments remained healthy during the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand momentum from a retail point of view still seems to be intact.
demand_outlook.quote: However, of course, there are certain input costs and margin pressures. But the demand from a retail point of view, still seems to be intact.

demand_outlook.claim: CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: So CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant at Chakan is being set up for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra.
capex_expansion.quote: • A new plant at Chakan for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra, while simultaneously optimizing product lines between this facility and the existing ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: • The previously announced mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of this year, where we are consolidating four entities, Lumax Yokowo, Lumax Alps Alpine, Lumax Ituran and Lumax FAE, under one roof to optimize resources and fixed costs.

capex_expansion.claim: To cater to Mahindra's requirements, a new facility will be set up in Nashik for Greenfuel Energy.
capex_expansion.quote: • At Greenfuel Energy, we are pleased to report that we onboarded Mahindra as a new customer and to cater to their requirements, we shall be setting up a new facility in Nashik.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the first quarter stood at INR 23 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the 1st Quarter was INR 23 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: Consolidated capex for Q1 FY27 was INR 23 crores.
Capex during the year was INR 233 crore, including strategic land investments and capacity expansions.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the year was INR 233 crore, which included strategic investment in land in Gujarat and Kharkhoda Region of INR 45 crore and also almost INR 100 crore on capacity expansions in IAC and Lumax Alps Alpine.

capex_expansion.claim: Projected capital expenditure for the year is expected to be between INR 275 crore and INR 300 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: capacity, I would say, is pretty much in line with the OEM growth plan, and it is reflected in our capex plans for the year, which Ankit had mentioned, it would be anywhere between INR 275 crore to INR 300 crore.

margins_costs.claim: The effective tax rate continues to remain at around 25% and is expected to hold at similar levels going forward.
margins_costs.quote: The effective tax rate continues to remain at around 25%, which is also expected to hold at similar levels way forward.

margins_costs.claim: Inflationary pressures have put some short-term pressure on margins.
margins_costs.quote: So Amit, most of the inflationary costs, be it on account of raw material commodities or also the manpower cost, which has significantly risen up due to certain minimum wage hikes, also the energy price is going up, all of it has, of course, put some short-term pressure on the margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company has a back-to-back understanding with OEMs for inflationary costs with a 3 to 6-month lag.
margins_costs.quote: It is just a lag of about 3 to 6 months depending on the OEM by when we get these realizations.

margins_costs.claim: Full year margins should sustain or increase by at least 30 bps on top line growth.
margins_costs.quote: So for the full year, I do not foresee any reason that the margins would get negatively impacted. On the contrary, I would say, on account of the top line growth, the margin should just sustain or at least further go up by at least 30 bps or so.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore providing healthy business visibility.
orders_capacity.quote: We are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore, which provides a healthy visibility for the business going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Of the total order book, approximately 24% is expected to be executed in FY27, 56% in FY28, and the remaining 20% in FY29.
orders_capacity.quote: Of this order book, approximately 24% is expected to be executed in this FY 27 itself, 56% in FY 28, and the remaining 20% in FY 29.

orders_capacity.claim: The Advanced Plastics division holds an order book of INR 787 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book remains strong at INR 787 crore for this division, providing solid future visibility.

orders_capacity.claim: The Mechatronics segment has a healthy order book of close to INR 500 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Mechatronics segment sustained its upward momentum, delivering a y-o-y increase of almost 56% in Q1 FY 27 from INR 54 to INR 84 crore, with a very healthy order book of close to INR 500 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The Structure and Control Systems vertical reported an order book of INR 130 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: It reported a y-o-y growth of 21% in Q1, increasing from INR 180 crore to INR 220 crore with an order book of INR 130 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The Alternate Fuels business reported an order book of INR 200 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Alternate Fuels business showed a growth of 17% y-o-y from INR 95 to INR 111 crore with an order book of INR 200 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book is scheduled to progress in stages, achieving full completion by FY29.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book is set to progress in stages achieving full completion by FY29.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported a robust order book of INR 1,450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Coming to the order book, we are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,450 crore, which provides healthy visibility for the business going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Advanced plastics contributed the largest share of the order book, followed by Mechatronics, alternate fuels, and Structures & Control Systems.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book continues to reflect a healthy traction across all our product verticals with advanced plastics contributing the largest share, followed by Mechatronics, alternate fuels and Structures & Control Systems.

orders_capacity.claim: Mechatronics segment order book stands at INR 400 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Mechatronics segment sustained upward momentum, delivering a y-o-y growth of almost 150% in FY 26 from INR 115 crore to INR 281 crore with a healthy order book of INR 400 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Structures & Control Systems vertical order book stands at INR 170 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: It reported a y-o-y growth of 17% in FY 26, increasing from INR 693 crore to INR 816 crore. With an order book of INR 170 crore, this strengthens our position as a trusted technology partner in the evolving mobility ecosystem.

orders_capacity.claim: Greenfuel energy business is backed by an order book of INR 180 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Greenfuel energy business acquired in November of last financial year contributed INR 383 crore in FY 26, backed by an order book of INR 180 crore with margins expected to be accretive to the Group average over the medium term.

orders_capacity.claim: Advanced plastics division order book remains strong at INR 700 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book remains strong at INR 700 crore, providing solid future visibility.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we continue to maintain a strong balance sheet and a healthy liquidity position. Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32.
capital_allocation.quote: The long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32, which is within our internal comfort thresholds.

capital_allocation.claim: The majority of the INR 300 crore capex will continue to be funded from internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The majority of the capex, INR 300 crore, will continue to fund from the internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the sale of the entire 50% equity stake in Lumax JOPP Allied Technologies to JOPP Holding Germany.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has also approved the sale of entire 50% equity stake in Lumax JOPP Allied Technologies Private Limited to JOPP Holding Germany, the Joint Venture partner, subject to completion of customary conditions in terms of the share purchase agreement.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a proposal to acquire the remaining 15.97% stake in Lumax FAE Technologies.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has also approved proposal to acquire the remaining stake of 15.97% in Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited, from its existing shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of March 2026, we continue to maintain a strong balance sheet and a healthy liquidity position. Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with ongoing conflict in the Middle East raising energy security concerns.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, heightening concerns around energy security, supply chain disruptions, and inflationary pressures.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains watchful of macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation, and energy price volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: In closing, while we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favourable, giving us confidence as we enter FY 27.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced labor shortages due to elections, war-related scenarios, or other conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: So yes, it is very much a fact and there is no point saying that there are no labour shortages that we have experienced either due to elections or due to the war-related scenario or other conditions.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031 under the 20.20.20.20 Vision.
management_commitments.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company aspires to more than double its current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore by FY 2031.
management_commitments.quote: And by FY 2031, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore, fueled by a blend of organic excellence and strategically inorganic opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a minimum 20% revenue CAGR from FY26 to FY31.
Management targets 20% ROCE and a 20% EBITDA margin vision by FY31.
Management targets 20+% of business coming from future and clean mobility.
The company is committed to executing its mid-term strategy backed by a robust order pipeline and diversified customer base.
management_commitments.quote: At Lumax Auto Technologies, we remain firmly committed to the execution of our mid-term strategy backed by a robust order pipeline, a diversified customer base and a very well-defined road map to evolve from a traditional Tier 1 supplier to a Tier 0.5 system integrator, we believe the Company is well positioned to deliver sustainable growth and strengthen its competitive position in the years ahead.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to maintain a minimum 35% dividend payout ratio.
management_commitments.quote: So the payout ratio, we have a very fair internal policy of maintaining a minimum 35% payout ratio and the Company continues to maintain that for the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
